name: Reduce Calendly No-Shows with WhatsApp Confirmations and Attendance Polls via Supergreen

parameters.content:
## Reduce Calendly no-shows with WhatsApp booking confirmations, 24h attendance polls, and 2h join-link nudges

### How it works

1. Listens for Calendly `invitee.created` and `invitee.canceled` webhooks and sends instant WhatsApp confirmations (or rebooking links) via Supergreen without Meta template approvals or per-message fees.
2. Logs every booking in Google Sheets with precomputed 24-hour attendance poll and 2-hour final join-link timestamps.
3. Runs an hourly sweep to send a 3-option native WhatsApp attendance poll 24 hours before the call and drops the live meeting link 2 hours before start time.
4. Captures real-time poll votes to mark invitees Confirmed, immediately DM their direct Calendly reschedule or cancel URL, and alert the host in Slack so freed slots get refilled.
5. Captures unhandled workflow errors via Error Trigger and posts alerts to Slack.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the `n8n-nodes-supergreen` community node and connect your WhatsApp number at [supergreen.cc/n8n](https://supergreen.cc/n8n?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=template&utm_campaign=calendly-whatsapp-polls).
- [ ] Add credentials for **Calendly OAuth2**, **Supergreen API**, **Google Sheets OAuth2**, and **Slack OAuth2**.
- [ ] Collect invitee phone numbers on your Calendly event type (via SMS reminder phone or a booking form question labeled Phone / WhatsApp).
- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with a `CalendlyBookings` tab containing columns: `bookingId`, `eventName`, `inviteeName`, `email`, `phone`, `startTimeIso`, `startTimeFormatted`, `joinUrl`, `rescheduleUrl`, `cancelUrl`, `pollDueAt`, `finalReminderDueAt`, `status`, `pollSent`, `pollMessageId`, `finalReminderSent`, `updatedAt`.
- [ ] Replace `SET_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID`, `SET_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID`, your brand name, and `rebookingUrl` across the configuration nodes and Slack error node.

### Customization

Adjust `pollHoursBefore` (default 24) and `finalReminderHoursBefore` (default 2) to match your sales or clinic workflow, or swap Google Sheets for HubSpot or Airtable.

## 1. Capture and normalize Calendly events

Listens for invitee.created and invitee.canceled webhooks, deduplicates retries, extracts phone numbers, and calculates 24h poll and 2h nudge times.

## 2. Split new bookings vs cancellations

Routes newly created bookings and Calendly cancellations into separate confirmation and host-alert paths.

## 3. Confirm new booking and log ledger

Sends an instant WhatsApp booking confirmation with the join and reschedule links and stores the booking in Google Sheets.

## 4. Handle Calendly cancellation

Sends a polite WhatsApp rebooking link, marks the row Canceled in Sheets, and alerts the host in Slack.

## 5. Find bookings due for poll or nudge

Runs hourly to scan upcoming bookings in Google Sheets and flag rows entering their 24-hour poll or 2-hour final join-link window.

## 6. Route due reminder stage

Separates 24-hour interactive attendance polls from 2-hour final join-link reminders.

## 7. Send 24h WhatsApp attendance poll

Sends a 3-option attendance confirmation poll via Supergreen and saves pollMessageId to match live votes.

## 8. Send 2h final join-link nudge

Drops the direct meeting link on WhatsApp two hours before start time so invitees join on time with one tap.

## 9. Match attendance vote to booking

Triggers on Supergreen poll vote webhooks and retrieves the matching Calendly booking by pollMessageId in Google Sheets.

## 10. Validate vote and route decision

Filters unvotes and already-resolved bookings and routes confirmed, reschedule, and cancel selections down separate paths.

## 11. Lock in confirmed attendee

Marks the booking Confirmed in Google Sheets and reassures the invitee that their meeting link will arrive 2 hours prior.

## 12. Send instant reschedule link and alert host

Marks Reschedule Requested in Sheets, sends the invitee's direct Calendly reschedule URL on WhatsApp, and alerts the host in Slack.

## 13. Release slot on cancel vote

Marks Cancel Requested in Sheets, sends the direct Calendly cancel link on WhatsApp, and alerts the host in Slack to reclaim the time slot.

## 14. Alert Slack on workflow errors

Captures unhandled errors via Error Trigger and posts the failing node and error message to Slack.
